priorityList: Ensure your pet is summoned and use Aspect of the Eagle if you are out of melee range (6+ yards).
Use offensive racials, potions, and trinkets when Takedown is active or ready to be cast.
Cast Kill Command if you have 0 stacks of Tip of the Spear.
Cast Kill Command to generate Tip of the Spear stacks if Takedown's cooldown is almost refreshed (less than 1.5 seconds remaining).
Cast Takedown if Tip of the Spear is active (you may cast it at 0 stacks if the Twin Fangs talent is taken).
Cast Boomstick if you have a stack of Tip of the Spear active.
Cast Wildfire Bomb if you have a stack of Tip of the Spear active and you are about to reach maximum charges (less than 4 seconds until a charge refreshes).
Cast Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) if Tip of the Spear is active.
Cast Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) if the Raptor Swipe (or Mongoose Fury) buff is missing or about to expire.
Cast Kill Command as your primary filler to generate Tip of the Spear stacks whenever Takedown is on cooldown.
Cast Wildfire Bomb as a filler if no other priority actions are available.
Cast Takedown as a fallback if it is available and no other conditions are met.
